messages:
nora_sre: Following up on the postmortem action items — consolidating owners/timelines for GPU capacity + autoscale fixes. I'll keep this thread as the live tracker.

ashley_platform: I'll take the scheduler tuning experiments. Plan: try targetUtil=0.72, add minimal pre-warm of 1 GPU, and tune gracePeriod to 60s. Running against staging workload this afternoon.

devon_scheduler: I'll draft the quota request for the dedicated eu-west pool. Suggest +6 GPUs with a 2-step release: +3 immediate, +3 in 21 days pending headroom report.

maria_capacity: I'll run the headroom sims with the latest traffic slice (including batch bursts at 03:00 UTC). Expect a short report by Tue EOD.

ben_oncall: Oncall will publish an "emergency scale" checklist to ops-playbooks and add the manual kubectl steps. Also will create a Slack shortcut to trigger a warmup job.

jake_finance: FYI I'll need monthly cost delta and justification for the quota bump. Put estimates in the PR and tag me.

infra-bot: Created INF-4602: "Headroom sim + schedule for batch jobs" (owner: maria_capacity) | due 2024-07-09

nora_sre: Owners and dates we agreed:
- scheduler experiments (staging + canary) — @ashley_platform — due 2024-07-11
- quota request + PR — @devon_scheduler — due 2024-07-13
- headroom sim report — @maria_capacity — due 2024-07-09
- ops emergency runbook + shortcut — @ben_oncall — due 2024-07-08
- finance signoff coordination — @jake_finance — due 2024-07-15

ashley_platform: Canary plan: deploy scheduler change to 10% of inference traffic, monitor 95/99 latencies and error rate for 6 hours, then 25% for 12h, then full. Health gates: no >5% increase in 99th latency, error rate under 0.5%.

devon_scheduler: PR link: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/781 — includes cost delta and rollback plan. Tagging @jake_finance for approval.

maria_capacity: Quick sim snapshot: peak aligned with batch window needs extra 3 GPUs for tails; with 20% safety -> recommend +1 pre-warm GPU and +2 quota. Full CSV uploaded: https://internal/reports/headroom-22456.csv

ben_oncall: Runbook snippet added. Manual steps and quick health checks:
```
# emergency scale-up
kubectl patch hpa inference-hpa -n redwood -p '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 20}}'
# verify pods ready and KV warm; trigger warmup-job: /ops/warmup start
```
Also added a Slack workflow to kick warmup.

nora_sre: Recurring incident pattern note: most surges align with ETL batch jobs at 03:00 UTC and with external partner syncs. Action: either shift job windows or add smoothing. @maria_capacity @ashley_platform please propose options.

ashley_platform: I'll add a scheduler rule to deprioritize batch pods during peak windows and add rate-limiting to the ETL job queue. Will include config in the scheduler ticket.

maria_capacity: I'll test shifting batch to 05:00 UTC in sim and report impact. If shift reduces tail by >30% we recommend schedule change.

jake_finance: If we can reduce recurring extra GPUs via schedule shifts, that helps the budget case. I'll model both scenarios once Maria posts numbers.

devon_scheduler: After quota PR merges, I'll update dedicated pool sizing and add monitoring alerts for headroom thresholds.

infra-bot: Created INF-4603: "Quota bump PR 781 review" (owner: devon_scheduler) | due 2024-07-13

nora_sre: Great progress. Let's reconvene in 5 days in this thread — please paste links to PRs, canary logs, and the final headroom CSV. Closing note: prioritize both short-term safety (manual runbook + quota) and medium-term fixes (scheduler tuning + job windowing).

ashley_platform: Will post staging results and canary playbook link here.

maria_capacity: Report will be in by Tue EOD.

ben_oncall: Runbook and Slack shortcut live. Monthly headroom report scheduled.

jake_finance: Ready to review the cost numbers when posted.

nora_sre: Thanks team.
